# Skribli

Skribli is a local-first contextual notes application for Windows 10 and Windows 11 currently in active production development.

## Core product

- Focus the application where the note belongs.
- Press Ctrl + Shift + Space.
- Skribli attaches one note to the foreground application automatically.
- Write immediately in a small paper-like editor.
- Close the note into a compact attached tab.
- Empty overlay space must remain click-through.
- The application runs quietly from the Windows system tray.
- Normal note use is designed not to require an account or cloud sync.

## Difference from ordinary sticky notes

Ordinary sticky notes mainly preserve text in standalone note windows. Skribli is designed around application context: a note belongs to the software where it is useful and returns with that context.

## Availability

- Platform under active development: Windows 10 and Windows 11, x64
- Public downloads: paused
- macOS: not available
- Website: https://skribly-desktop.vercel.app/
- Production notes: https://skribly-desktop.vercel.app/release-notes
- Privacy policy: https://skribly-desktop.vercel.app/privacy
- FAQ: https://skribly-desktop.vercel.app/answers

## Current production work

The previous Windows beta has been withdrawn while the following behaviour is rebuilt and validated:

- no release terminal window;
- no permanent floating toolbar or saved-notes widget;
- automatic foreground-app attachment from the shortcut;
- selective click-through outside note and editor bounds;
- clear save, close, hide, delete, and quit controls;
- natural note-taking typography;
- installer icons regenerated from the approved Skribli brand asset.

No public installer should be presented until these native Windows runtime checks pass.

## Privacy

Skribli is designed to store note data locally. The public website currently uses no advertising cookies or behavioural analytics. Public installer delivery is disabled during the production rebuild.
